changes: Rough menu procurement ignores expiry dates for active stock; inventory expiry reminders remain.

Low stock covers one pending dish in the selected week; two or more occurrences generate the recipe-based purchase requirement. Counts are per canonical ingredient and planned dish, independent of servings or duplicate ingredient rows.
Adequate and surplus bands still cover weekly demand; exact quantity forecasting and independent manual shopping are preserved.
General assistant and weekly planner prompts follow the same procurement policy.

regression: Expired low stock covers one six-person dish even when unrelated dishes exist.
A second dish using the same canonical ingredient generates procurement; known ingredient aliases match.
Removing the second dish removes procurement; scheduling the same recipe twice counts as two dishes.
Expired adequate and surplus stock still covers multiple dishes.
Existing tests cover plan refresh, manual isolation, purchases, restart, undo, depleted stock and exact forecasting.

limitations: Isolated SQLite and browser IPC tests; no live model, two-device production sync or overwrite installation test.
